facts.name: Program description
facts.detail: Department graduate page: the master's program offers a comprehensive education in Computer Science and prepares students to enter the technology industry.
facts.quote: Our Master's Program at Cal State LA offers a comprehensive education in the rapidly changing and emerging field of Computer Science and prepares students to enter the competitive technology industry.

facts.name: Research path units
facts.detail: Graduate page: with advisor approval, the research path is 18 units of 4000/5000-level courses plus thesis and project courses.
facts.quote: With the approval of the CS advisor, choose 18 units of 4000/5000 level courses as well as the Thesis and Project courses.

facts.name: Comprehensive path units
facts.detail: Graduate page: the comprehensive path is 24 units of 4000/5000-level courses plus a comprehensive examination.
facts.quote: Complete 24 units of 4000/5000 level courses and undertake a comprehensive examination to demonstrate your knowledge.

facts.name: Bachelor's degree and 3.0 GPA for applicants
facts.detail: Graduate page: anyone with a bachelor's in CS or a closely related field and an overall 3.0 GPA may apply; prerequisites may be required for non-CS or non-ABET CS backgrounds.
facts.quote: Anyone with a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a closely related field with an overall GPA of 3.0 may apply. Prerequisite courses may be required for non-CS students or for students from non-ABET accredited CS programs.

facts.name: GRE and letters not required
facts.detail: Graduate page: GRE and recommendation letters are not required.
facts.quote: GRE and Recommendation letters are NOT required

facts.name: Conditional admission GPA range
facts.detail: Graduate page: promising applicants with a GPA between 2.5 and 2.99 may be conditionally admitted.
facts.quote: Promising applicants with a GPA between 2.5 and 2.99 may be conditionally admitted and are encouraged to apply

facts.name: Classified standing GPA
facts.detail: Admission page: a bachelor's in CS or a closely related field with an overall GPA of 3.0 or better is needed for classified graduate standing (full admission).
facts.quote: Applicants must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a closely related field with an overall GPA of 3.0 or better to be considered for full admission

facts.name: Special action / conditional GPA 2.5-2.99
facts.detail: Admission page: a promising applicant with GPA 2.5-2.99 may be conditionally admitted as a special action student and must earn a 3.0 in four department-approved qualifying courses.
facts.quote: A promising applicant with a GPA between 2.5 and 2.99 may be conditionally admitted as a special action student.

facts.name: Prerequisite cap for non-CS or non-ABET applicants
facts.detail: Admission page: promising non-CS or non-ABET CS applicants may be given up to three prerequisites.
facts.quote: These students are given up to three prerequisites (based on the evaluation of their transcripts).

facts.name: Application is two steps
facts.detail: Admission page: the application process is centralized and requires two steps.
facts.quote: The application process is centralized at the university and requires TWO steps as described below:

facts.name: Degree unit total (department curriculum page headed 2023-2024)
facts.detail: The department curriculum page is titled 2023-2024 Requirements. It states the M.S. requires 30 units. The current e-catalog program page could not be fetched (AWS WAF).
facts.quote: The MS CS degree requires the completion of 30 units.

facts.name: Advance to candidacy
facts.detail: Planner: students ready for a thesis or the comprehensive exam should advance after at least 12 units and a 3.0 GPA.
facts.quote: The minimum requirement for candidacy advancement are the completion of 12 units and a minimum GPA of 3.0.

facts.name: Thesis course CS 5990
facts.detail: Planner: CS 5990 should be taken exactly twice.
facts.quote: CS 5990 should be taken exactly twice.

facts.name: Graduate writing requirement
facts.detail: Planner: GWAR is no longer required for graduate students, effective for catalog years beginning Fall 2023.
facts.quote: The Graduate Writing Assessment Requirement (GWAR) is no longer required for graduate students, effective for catalog years beginning Fall 2023.
